title: Windows migration inventory, reproducible workspace restore and Codex handoff
objective: Publish a reviewable migration guide, six-repository snapshot and reproducible restore script plus an explicit Windows Codex handoff, preserving unfinished CORE-002 and private local evidence.
in_scope: Foundation migration guide and sanitized reusable handoff prompt explicitly requested by the owner
Six repository remote/branch/checkpoint manifest and clone/verify script with non-destructive defaults
Separate private local transport archive of MC outputs, Codely history, ignored data and selected configuration; no credentials or private archive in Git
Validate Foundation gates, publish migration branch to GitHub and preserve CORE-002 branch without claiming implementation complete
out_of_scope: No product feature changes, no public API changes, no production deployment or paid provider calls
No implementation resumption or release of the Core/Ops handoff locks
No migration of Codex authentication databases or unrelated projects; no secret values or raw chat histories in Git
acceptance_evidence: docs/windows-migration.md: WSL2 agent route, native Windows write boundary, versions, reconstruction and private-data inventory.
migration/windows-20261020.json and scripts/restore-workspace.ps1: six origins, exact product checkpoints, Foundation migration descendant and non-destructive restore.
memory/handoffs/2026-10-20-windows.md and templates/windows-codex-handoff-prompt.md: current snapshot, custody, explicit receiving protocol and unfinished product work.
Core e7e83ca pushed on the existing active branch; Ops ef00a72 pushed on its active branch; all other product remote heads match the manifest.

Private local transport archive prepared: six verified Git bundles, 1621 files including historical MC outputs/Codely/5 MC JSONL sessions, ignored local instructions and Skin data/config; credentials/auth databases excluded except local project env and Mac config retained privately for manual reference.

Three stopped PostgreSQL databases exported as cold readonly snapshots and logical dumps from temporary copies; each logical dump restored successfully into a brand-new isolated cluster with psql ON_ERROR_STOP=1. Original volumes/containers retained, temporary resources removed.

The archive payload hashes were all read back and verified; final packaging refresh will include this closeout commit. Windows execution and actual receiver environment acceptance remain receiver steps, not claims of this migration-preparation task.
